title: Sam and the Dinosaurs
can_do: 向没见过的人描述一个新朋友的外貌和喜好，并回答追问。

conversation_move.label: describe a person's looks and likes

trigger: Mom has not met the new classmate and asks Child what he is like.
setting: Evening chat in the living room.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: You said a new kid joined your class today.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! His name is Sam, and he loves dinosaurs.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: He has brown curly fur and a green backpack.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: No, mine is blue. His has a T-rex on it.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: We dug in the sandbox. He knows every dinosaur!

replay_cards.title: The new music teacher
replay_cards.setting: A new music teacher starts at school.
replay_cards.change: Mom has not met her yet.
replay_cards.challenge: Child describes her as the tall one with gray fur who plays guitar, and tells one thing she did in class.

replay_cards.title: Max's baby sister
replay_cards.setting: Max got a baby sister last week.
replay_cards.change: Dad has not heard the news yet.
replay_cards.challenge: Child describes the baby as tiny with brown fur who sleeps a lot, and answers Dad's follow-up questions.

parent_support: 听孩子讲新朋友时，追问“长什么样、喜欢什么”两个维度。
孩子描述卡住时，提示“他的书包是什么样”，不替他总结。
最后留一个开放问题“你们一起玩了什么”，让描述落到事上。
